title: Paying several invoices at once includes only what the viewer's customer owes
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks a customer portal change that ships in the customer portal app's own release (the Bill To PRD's release dependency for the customer portal story). Do not run it now. It can be tested once that portal release is out.

Preconditions

  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $150.00, unpaid, billed to customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, invoiced for $60.00, unpaid, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as contact A1.
  2. Choose to pay several invoices at once.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Contact A1, customer A's contact, is signed in.

Step 2:

  • Only work order 2's invoice ($60.00) is included.
  • Work order 1's invoice, owed by customer B, is not included.
